whatIs: CSS-Peeps draws characters in the style of Open Peeps using only CSS: one file and one div. A configurator lets you choose the head, face, accessories, facial hair and body, and change colors, zoom and rotation through custom properties.
It's a good fit when you want illustrations of people for avatars or team sections without loading images, and with the ability to change them from CSS. You install it from npm.
uses: Creating team or testimonial avatars by customizing colors with variables like --peep-hair-color.
Changing the character on hover using the variants API in :hover.
Generating decorative illustrations for a landing page without relying on image files.
caveats: The @property export works in fewer browsers than the one compatible with :where(), but the latter requires you to define the variants in the HTML.
The configurator is desktop only, the API documentation is incomplete and the repository hasn't received changes since 2022.
The scale properties, such as --peep-head-scale, are still incomplete and will change, so it's best not to use them.
pricingNote: Open source under the BSD-2-Clause license; the base illustrations come from Open Peeps.
idealFor: Websites that want customizable illustrated characters using only CSS.
